|printed_game_text=<span lang="ja">搭乗する宇宙船の戦闘力と回避値に＋1。その宇宙船がイオン砲の命中を受けた場合、次の自分の支配フェイズに回避値／装甲値と航行速度を回復させる。</span>
|printed_lore=<span lang="ja">操縦用として用いられることは滅多にない。R5ユニットは船体を管理し、イオン化によるダメージを補修する能力で知られる。</span>
|translation='''Title''' — [[R5-A2 (Arfive-Aytoo)]].

'''Lore''' — They are seldom used for piloting. R5 units are known for managing hulls and repairing damage caused by ionization.

'''Game text''' — Adds 1 to the power and maneuver of the starship he is aboard. If that starship is hit by an ion cannon, restore maneuver/armor and hyperspeed during your next control phase.
|translation_note=Japanese restores 回避値／装甲値 then hyperspeed. English restores armor/maneuver and hyperspeed. Lore says seldom used for piloting, not navigation.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-r5a2-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[R5-A2 (Arfive-Aytoo)]].</ref>
